The sentence "Currently, the assessment of the chemical status of a given ecosystem" sets up a methodological or conceptual gap statement, implying a limitation or shortcoming of the existing biodiversity indices.

Final token "ecosystem" ends a relative clause ("to characterize the chemical status of a given ecosystem...so far...mainly focuses on evaluating the chemical state of an environment"), requiring a predicate like "is limited" or "has not included..." or "focuses only on..." or "or cost." or "by providing useful results." — a concluding statement about the method.

Technical chemical engineering document systematically describing reactor design tradeoffs, with ongoing argument about catalytic reforming process constraints.

The sentence "This increases the partial pressure of water and the CO2 pressure" is building a consequence statement about the byproduct limitation — the high water/CO2 concentration in the reactor effluent.

Final token "pressure" ends a clause ("thereby increasing the water vapor pressure and the CO2 pressure"), requiring a predicate — likely "also increases" or "in the reactor must be controlled" or "becomes prohibitively high, requiring special downstream separation." or "which limits the reaction" or "in the product stream is also elevated."

Science journalism structure: article is presenting a study summary, with factual reporting on genetic mutations linked to schizophrenia.

The sentence "Researchers have found a mutation linked to schizophrenia and brain enlargement in people with schizophrenia" signals a new finding or conclusion about the study's core claim.

Final token "schizophrenia" ends a relative clause ("the mutation found at the root of schizophrenia linked to schizophrenia..."), requiring a predicate — likely "are more common in the evolutionary lineage" or "may be the cause of the disorder" or "mirror the cognitive dysfunction of the broader population." or "have been traced to a shared evolutionary origin" linking the mutation to the excess.

Patent document describing a coating process, systematically presenting technical limitations of UV curing of pigment dispersions in aqueous photoresist systems.

The sentence "The problem is that the resin/pigment mixtures" is a concluding statement about the disadvantages of the cured product, implying a summary of instability or poor adhesion of heterogeneous mixtures.

Final token "mixtures" ends a clause ("because the coating mixtures...and the pigment mixtures"), requiring a predicate — likely "are not uniform" or "tend to be difficult to process" or "produced thereby." or "often lack compatibility" or "also exhibit poor adhesion." or "are not ideal." — a consequence statement about the resulting heterogeneous product.
